description: Zero Dark, Borro's dark pool for stock tokens on Robinhood Chain: whether it is open, the sessions and the next batch (a call auction per market once a minute in US regular hours, at the reference midpoint), each market's reference price and where it comes from, its book size (never depth), lot size and caps, the fee, and what is hidden and what is not.

title: Zero Dark: the venue and its markets
